shots.name: desktop_day_banner
shots.js: t.ui.help(false); t.time.setHour(10); t.ui.banner('inner_city'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1800)); return t.time.get().full;

shots.name: desktop_dusk_dragged
shots.js: t.time.setHour(18.45, { scrub: true }); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); t.time.setHour(18.45); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); return t.time.get().full;

shots.name: desktop_night_set
shots.js: t.time.setHour(21.5); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); return t.time.get().full;

shots.name: desktop_local
shots.js: t.time.toLocal(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); return t.time.get();

shots.name: desktop_focus
shots.js: t.time.setHour(13.2); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'KeyT', key: 't', bubbles: true })); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); return document.querySelector('.qm-time').className;
